name: Darrkong/Airbnb_host_retention
what_it_holds: Single Jupyter notebook (Host_Retention.ipynb) implementing a simple listing-survival/churn method: pulls Inside Airbnb Los Angeles listings.csv.gz for the 2017-04-02 scrape and the 2018-05-09 scrape and labels a listing 'discontinued' if its ID present in 2017 is absent in 2018. No data committed to the repo (external download only), single city, two snapshots.
why_useful: Confirms specific old Inside Airbnb LA vintages (2017-04, 2018-05) that are off the current CDN and demonstrates a minimal ID-matching churn method that could be re-applied to any two vintages we still hold or can recover.
size_hint: Two listings.csv.gz files (not committed), typical LA scrape size (tens of thousands of rows)
duplicate_of_holding: Partially — we already hold a 13-city Inside Airbnb panel including LA-adjacent methodology, but not these specific 2017/2018 vintages
themes: STR listing-level histories compiled by researchers (listing survival, churn, professionalisation, multi-year listing IDs across cities)
why_all: Confirms specific old Inside Airbnb LA vintages (2017-04, 2018-05) that are off the current CDN and demonstrates a minimal ID-matching churn method that could be re-applied to any two vintages we still hold or can recover.
